name: moin-ai
description: Manage a moinAI customer service chatbot from Claude. Connects to the moinAI MCP server (https://api.moin.ai/mcp) to create and configure AI agents, write knowledge documents, attach websites and PDFs as knowledge, wire up webhook integrations as AI actions, and test answers in the playground. Ships the bot-management playbook as a skill, so Claude knows the staging/live model and the end-to-end workflows. All write operations are confined to staging. Requires a moinAI account; authenticates with your Hub login over OAuth.
